title: Azusawa Kohane — A Sweet Moment〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, food's ready. Pancakes for Akito, and a sandwich for Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll cut the cake for Kohane and An in a flash. Just one second.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What about my parfait, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't you worry, it'll be right out.
Miku, can you get the drinks out first for me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure.
Len, you should help too if you've got nothing better to do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whaaat? I'm all tired from practice, though.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like the rest of us? Come on, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, I can—
Excuse meee!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? A customer...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd say so. That wasn't Rin, Luka or KAITO's voice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? But if it's not them, who would it be?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know... I'll go look.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sorry about the wait!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, no one's here...?
Hey, I'm here! Right here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Where's this voice coming from...?
I said I'm right here! Look down!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Down...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Nice to meet you! I'm Memetchi!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: So yeah, I was listening to this wonderfully cool song, and before I knew it I was here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Think that needs more than a “so yeah”...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mentioned that you live on Tamagotchi Planet, which makes you an extraterrestrial visitor...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, but based on the other details of your story, it's quite possible that you're currently in a dream influenced by your friend Mametchi's sleep-learning machine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, what's up with this “sleep-learning”?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I recall, you said it was a matter of hearing what you want to learn repeatedly in your sleep and committing it to memory that way.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Right! I was supposed to hear a sample performance of the choir song we're all gonna sing together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you heard something else instead... That must have been Kohane and the others practicing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's hard to believe all this stuff about Tamagotchi Planet and sleep-learning machines is real.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It is pretty shocking, but Memetchi being right here in front of us proves it's not a dream!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, it is for Memetchi though, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Hm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't actually get what's going on, do you... Not that I'm much different.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: I get why you're all surprised.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: I mean, if things were the other way around, I don't think I could believe you right away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't say that. I believe you, Memetchi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just a gut feeling, but I can tell you're not a liar.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Also...
This place was created out of the feelings the four of us share.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Out of feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. So, this place is pretty mysterious already... All kinds of stuff can happen, so this just feels like one of the possibilities.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We certainly didn't predict any extraterrestrial visitors, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, that's true.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! Why don't we sing for Memetchi to celebrate becoming friends?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sounds like a good idea to me. Give our new friend a chance to hear your “wonderfully cool” singing from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! What do you think, Shinonome, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Guess we're doing this thing...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Huh...? Everyone looks...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Surprised? This is how they sing.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: I-It's amazing! How do they blow you away like that...?!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Just listening to them has this intense feeling burning inside me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... Thanks for listening, Memetchi.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me listen!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: It was just as wonderfully cool as I remembered! I'd love it if you could teach me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Glad to hear... Wait, what did you just say?

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line:
I said I was hoping you'd teach me.
I told you we're practicing for that recital, right?

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: We tried a bunch of times, but we never got in sync.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: That's why we were gonna listen to the song over and over with the sleep-learning machine and learn it that way.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: But when I heard you all sing, I figured something out!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: I got brought here so I could ask you for help!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: With how amazing you are, you might think a school performance is no big deal, but...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: I'm serious about doing it right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Memetchi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (You suddenly ended up someplace totally unfamiliar, all on your own, but you're not flustered or afraid.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (After just meeting us, you're expressing your own feelings and opinions openly.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was with An when I first came to SEKAI, and even then, I was so jumpy the whole time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey, guys...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know what you're gonna say, Kohane. You wanna help Memetchi, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're done with practice, so I guess we could.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We can hardly reject such an earnest request, after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you'll have us, we'd be happy to help with your singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone!
